hero.eyebrow: Free. Open source. A little more you.
demo.hint: A little more room to breathe.
meta.title: PecoFence: glass fences for your Windows 11 desktop
meta.description: Make room for what matters. Organize files in glass panels, switch projects with tabs and bring your desktop into reach with one shortcut. Free and open source.
hero.headline: Make room
hero.text: Make room for what matters. Organize files in glass panels, switch projects with tabs and bring your desktop into reach with one shortcut. Free and open source.
hero.download_note: Microsoft Store edition, signed by Microsoft. Or the portable ZIP for x64: no account, no installer. Apache 2.0 license.
hero.panels_alt: Projects, inspiration and everyday files, each in its own native Liquid Glass group.
hero.caption: Native demo panels · Liquid Glass
watch.title: Watch the 30-second tour
watch.text: Auto-sorting and project tabs in half a minute. Original soundtrack, no voiceover, English on-screen text.
features.heading: Everything in its right place.
features.intro: Real PecoFence screenshots and recordings, made with demonstration files. Press play to see each workflow.
feature.groups.title: Make a fence
feature.groups.text: Drag files in. Resize the fence and snap it beside the others.
feature.portal.title: Keep a folder close
feature.portal.text: A live folder on your desktop. Open subfolders and watch changes arrive as they happen.
feature.tabs.title: Tabs for related groups
feature.tabs.text: From project files to inspiration. Just switch tabs.
feature.peek.title: Your desktop, one shortcut away
feature.peek.text: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd> to bring your fences above the current app. <kbd>Esc</kbd> takes you back.
feature.hide.title: Clear some space
feature.hide.text: Double-click the desktop to hide every fence, and again to bring them back. Roll a fence up to its title when you need the room.
feature.rules.title: Less sorting
feature.rules.text: Rules by file type, name, wildcard, age or size file new items into the right fence. Files stay where they are on disk.
details.heading: Small details, better everyday use
detail.glass.title: Glass that fits your wallpaper
detail.glass.text: Fluent and Liquid Glass themes, light and dark modes, per-fence colors, opacity and icon tinting.
detail.files.title: Familiar file handling
detail.files.text: Explorer context menus, drag and drop, copy and paste, multi-select, thumbnails, and icon, list or details views.
detail.space.title: Space when you need it
detail.space.text: Roll a fence up to its title bar. Hover to expand. Lock a layout once you like it.
detail.back.title: A way back
detail.back.text: Layout snapshots, daily backups, configuration import and export, and swapping fences between displays.
detail.footprint.title: A small footprint
detail.footprint.text: A native Rust application. The settings panel loads WebView2 only when you open it.
detail.safe.title: Your files stay yours
detail.safe.text: Automatic rules only change which fence shows a file. Moves you start yourself work exactly like Explorer.
languages.heading: Speaks your language
languages.text: Switch instantly in Settings, General, Display language, or follow Windows. Every translation ships inside the app and works offline. Your file names and custom fence names are never rewritten.
languages.readme: Read the README in this language
download.heading: Get PecoFence
download.step1: Download the latest pecofence-<version>-x64.zip from the releases page.
download.step2: Extract the whole ZIP into a folder and run pecofence.exe.
download.step3: Start organizing. The tray icon opens Settings whenever you need it.
download.winget: Prefer the command line? winget install DayuanJiang.PecoFence installs the same build and skips the SmartScreen prompt.
download.first_run: The first launch creates Programs, Folders, Files and documents, and Desktop fences in your language. Your desktop icons come back when you exit.
download.req2: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 11 already includes, for the Settings window.
download.req4: Portable builds are unsigned. If Windows SmartScreen appears on first launch, choose More info, then Run anyway. Installing from the Microsoft Store or through winget avoids the prompt.
